BAYESIAN METHODS / INFERENCE
THE CHALLENGE

Missing observations and measurement errors can complicate statistical inference.

THE APPROACH

Bayesian Jackknife Empirical Likelihood combines flexible inference with uncertainty assessment.

WHY IT MATTERS

Supports more reliable analysis when real-world data are imperfect.

01 / 06 · BIOSTATISTICS2025 ↗

Bayesian Jackknife Empirical Likelihood

Methodological research addressing missing data and measurement error in statistical inference.

Explore research ↗

Research question — How can inference remain reliable when observations are missing or measured with error?

Approach — Developed a Bayesian Jackknife Empirical Likelihood framework for statistical inference.

Value — Supports more careful uncertainty assessment when analyzing imperfect datasets.

03 / WHAT I BRINGTHE THINKING BEHIND THE WORK

Evidence is
my starting
point.

I work at the intersection of statistics, actuarial thinking, and machine learning.

My background combines mathematical statistics, biostatistical research, public health analytics, and applied AI. I use rigorous methods to make complicated questions easier to answer and findings easier to act on.

From healthcare data to predictive models, I care about work that is technically sound, clearly communicated, and useful beyond the spreadsheet.
